evidence_text: Additionally, the APT can be seen as a "supply-side" model, since its beta coefficients reflect the sensitivity of the underlying asset to economic factors. Factor shocks would cause structural changes in assets' expected returns, or in the case of stocks, in firms' profitabilities.
mechanism: As a supply-side model, factor shocks in the APT cause structural changes in assets' expected returns.
